decisions.reason: After four years the aspiration level is tougher than at launch, but this resin injection unit still fits a core application area and can be supported efficiently through existing engineering, service and distributor resources.

Because it overlaps closely with another resin injection unit, any performance shortfall is more likely to trigger problemistic search and resource reallocation toward the stronger core offering or new development.

The automatic airless spray gun remains tightly aligned with the firm's established spraying business and customer base, so management would usually continue it unless results were clearly below aspiration.
This manual airless spray gun is a highly familiar and central product type for the firm, making continued retention more likely given channel fit, serviceability and lower organizational strain.

The data logger is less central than the firm's main mechanical equipment lines, and if its market response has remained uncertain the firm would likely redeploy scarce development and support resources to stronger core products and new projects.
